primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Incidence of adverse events and monitoring of vital signs, clinical laboratory values, and electrocardiograms. All AEs were coded into preferred terms according to MedDRA (Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities) and classified by system organ class (SOC). Summaries of the incidence of all treatment-emergent AEs, treatment-related AEs, SAEs, and AEs leading to study drug discontinuation were prepared.
